\begin{aligned}\int \left(6-\frac{1}{\sqrt{t^{3}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}t &= \int \left(6-\frac{1}{t^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}t \\ &= 6\int 1\,\mathrm{d}t-\int t^{-\frac{3}{2}}\,\mathrm{d}t \\ &= 6\frac{t^{0+1}}{(0+1)}-\frac{t^{-\frac{3}{2}+1}}{(-\frac{3}{2}+1)}+C \\ &= 6t+\frac{2}{\sqrt{t}}+C\end{aligned}
$$
